.qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r16/task/tests/Dockerfile, tests/.dockerignore, tests/test.sh (grep), and all tests/**/*.toml and *.md (machine comparison against the public notes)
evidence: Source review of the frozen bytes; the agent image was not built or listed by me, so the /app contents are derived from the Dockerfile, not observed in a container. (1) task/environment/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the frozen template Dockerfile (diff empty). Its only COPY lines are 'COPY instructions/ /instructions/' and 'COPY assets/ /assets/' (lines 14-15); /app is created by 'mkdir -p /app', 'git -C /app init', 'touch /app/.gitkeep' and one commit of .gitkeep only. No COPY of solution/ or tests/. (2) The build context task/environment/ holds exactly 8 files: Dockerfile, assets/seed_data.json (149 bytes) and six notes; no hidden files, starter, skeleton, schema or partial UI. (3) seed_data.json is '{"snippets": [], "note": "No saved snippets are supplied in this seed. ..."}': no schema, route list or code. (4) The notes describe behaviour in prose and leave implementation open: policy.md 'You may choose the layout, labels, routes, database schema and error wording'; integration.md 'You may choose your routes and frontend tools'. The only fixed interface items are the launch contract (node /app/server.js, port 3000, GET /api/health, DB_PATH), which are inputs, not a deliverable. No code block, table definition or route list appears in any note. (5) Rubric reproduction: a token n-gram comparison of instruction.md, seed_data.json and the six notes against every tests/**/*.toml and *.md found zero shared runs of 12 words and zero shared runs of 8 words; none of the 55 cw_* criterion ids appears in any public file; a grep of the public files for judge|rubric|criteri|dimension|reward|weight|score.py|playwright|claude|glm|/tests|sentinel|GATE|solution|solve.sh|golden|oracle returned no match. (6) The verifier image is separate (task.toml environment_mode = "separate"; tests/Dockerfile 'COPY . /tests' applies to the verifier image only) and solve.sh copies solution/app into /app only when the oracle runs. task.toml artifacts are /app and /assets, which carry no answer. Weak-app/alternative probe for this row: an agent that only copies what the image supplies ends with an empty /app and cannot pass, consistent with the hosted nop reward 0 on the earlier candidate (that run is not a measurement of these bytes). Evidence index: all 16 scripted-golden artifacts match their recorded SHA256 as raw bytes; all 6 hosted-run JSON files match after LF normalisation, as the index states. Notes, not defects: (a) the notes are detailed prose (about 11.5 KB) but state requirements rather than reproduce criteria; overlap ownership sits with row 5 and check-instruction-hygiene. (b) Network is public and task.toml provenance says 'Adapted from the supplied Colderwater playground task'; I did not and could not check whether a finished copy of this app is publicly reachable online; nothing in the frozen bytes points to one.
